CVE-2026-128242.title: actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an u ...
CVE-2026-128242.description: actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an unbounded decompression vulnerability in encoding::Decoder that lets remote attackers exhaust memory and CPU via compressed bodies. Attackers can send small highly compressed gzip, deflate, Brotli or zstd request bodies to Json, Form, Bytes or String extractors, or serve them to awc clients, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-134341.title: actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulne ...
CVE-2026-134341.description: actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by sending large-window brotli request bodies. Attackers can send an 850-byte body with Content-Encoding: br declaring a 2^30 window, forcing about 1 GiB of decoder allocation per request and OOM-killing servers.

CVE-2026-134342.title: actix-http 3.18.10 before 3.20.2 contains an HTTP request smuggli ...
CVE-2026-134342.description: actix-http 3.18.10 before 3.20.2 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in its chunked decoder, which treats a bare LF after the last chunk as the start of a trailer section. Attackers can send a body ending in 0\r\n\n through a connection-reusing proxy so the next request's body is parsed as new requests, bypassing WAF or upstream protections.

CVE-2026-73051.title: actix-http versions before 3.12.1 contain an HTTP request smuggli ...
CVE-2026-73051.description: actix-http versions before 3.12.1 contain an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the HTTP/1.1 parser that accepts requests with both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked headers. Unauthenticated remote attackers can exploit this through a front-end intermediary to desynchronize backend requests and smuggle malicious HTTP requests to the Actix service.
